16ac616f6d8bb03dae37598e240c6688fcf15685.translatedText:
* Appears in a switch conditional statement; its effect is to terminate the case and exit the switch\.
* Appears in a loop statement; its effect is to exit the current loop statement\.
* Appears in a nested loop; it exits the nearest inner loop statement\.

16e2f597eb5d3e509e9f458a32b5e41168311ebc.sourceText: 这个开关影响节点与 TF 缓存时钟，但源码计算速度时另用 `std::chrono::steady_clock`。所以 True 不会让速度自动按仿真时间计算，也不会修复输入点时间单位或时钟同步问题。
16e2f597eb5d3e509e9f458a32b5e41168311ebc.translatedText: This switch affects the node and TF cache clock, but the source code uses `std::chrono::steady_clock` separately when calculating velocity\. So True will not make velocity automatically calculated according to simulation time, nor will it fix the input point time unit or clock synchronization issues\.

16ed78ef9f7521ef8b5a349fc0c785f2552b04cd.translatedText: In the C++ application\. For example, you might write a function named xyz(), and an identical function xyz() also exists in another available library\. In this case, the compiler cannot determine which xyz() function you are using\.
